## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `4b337ddd31363a7eefaea1d0d3e680c735115e32`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md, skills/objectstack-platform/evals/config-plugins-ops.json + content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx, content/docs/ui/forms.mdx, .changeset/28509-custom-override-read-teaching.md, packages/spec/src/kernel/override-declaration.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/kernel/customization-package.ts (OVERRIDE_TYPE_CLASSIFICATION / OVERRIDABLE_METADATA_TYPES), packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-plugin.zod.ts (allowEnvironmentOverlay rows), packages/metadata-protocol/src/served-override.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts (servedOverlayRowCandidates, readFlattenedMetaItems, getMetaItemLayered orphan block, declinesStoredRow, isSealedManagedItem, OVERLAY_ALLOWED_TYPES), packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-lock-state.ts, packages/rest/src/form-routes.ts (resolveFormBySlug), packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts (export door), packages/objectql/src/protocol-custom-override-effective-read.test.ts, content/docs/references/kernel/override-declaration.mdx + meta.json, skills/objectstack-data/references/seeds.md, skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md, skills/objectstack-platform/references/operations.md, skills/objectstack-platform/references/plugin-development.md, scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs, scripts/check-skill-identifier-liveness.mjs, docs/adr/0146 (D2, D3, D8, D9, D10, D11)

Inputs read: card #28509 body and all three comments (triage 6553647760, claim 6554345630, os-dev-report 6554702725); PR #28586 body, file list and `git diff origin/main...refs/review/pr-28586` (5 files, +58/-31, merge base 071bda62); PR #28507 body, file list and its changeset; epic #28236's N-30 row; the check-runs on the head.

Check-runs on `4b337ddd` at the time of writing: every reported run is `success` (Build Core, Build Docs, Check Changeset, Check Documentation Links, Check PR Size, Dogfood Regression Gate, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Lint & Repo Gates, all seven Lint lanes incl. docs & code guards and repo & tooling gates, Live E2E UI, PR-body guards, Spec property liveness, Test Core 2/8 and 3/8, Test UI, all four Type Check lanes, TypeScript Type Check). Still running: Test Core (1/8). No run has failed. The verdict below does not rest on the gates: the gates cannot see the two factual errors.

### ① Derived judgments

- The skill's accept set for "customize an installed package" moves from the Setup overlay row to the paired `hotcrm.custom` item declaring `overrides: { package, basedOn }` — **right** (ADR-0146 D2/D3; `override-declaration.zod.ts`; `servedOverlayRowCandidates` puts the pair's declaring row first).
- "honoured only from the pair (the row's `package_id`)", "never judges `basedOn`", "ignores any other package's declaration" — **right** (`isServedOverrideRowOf`: `isCustomizationPairOf(row.package_id, base)`, `overrides.package === base`, `basedOn` unread).
- "only for an overridable type (`OVERRIDABLE_METADATA_TYPES` in `@objectstack/spec/kernel`; not `flow`/`action` yet)" — **wrong as a description of the read on `main`**. The predicate does gate on `isOverridableMetadataType`, but every read asks `declinesStoredRow(type, name)` *before* the predicate: the by-name read (`storedRowDeclined`, protocol.ts, the `if (record && !storedRowDeclined)` arm), the list's override stand-ins (`overrideStandIns … .filter(!declinesStoredRow)`), and the layered read's `effective` (`!orphaned && !declinesStoredRow(...)`). `declinesStoredRow` is true for a shipped flow name AND for `isUnservedSealedOverlay` = `isSealedManagedItem` = artifact-backed name whose type is outside `OVERLAY_ALLOWED_TYPES` (derived from `allowEnvironmentOverlay`: `view`, `dashboard`, `report`, `email_template`, `translation`). `OVERRIDABLE_METADATA_TYPES` holds thirteen types: those five plus `page`, `app`, `dataset`, `doc`, `book`, `mapping`, `flow`, `action`. So on `main` a declared `.custom` override of a base `page`, `app`, `dataset`, `doc`, `book` or `mapping` is declined exactly as a flow's is, not served. PR #28507 pins the served read for `view` only (its test's `type: 'app'` is a manifest kind). The sentence, with its sole `flow`/`action` carve-out, teaches an agent that a `hotcrm.custom` page or app override is served today. The docs subsection repeats it ("only for an overridable type (`OVERRIDABLE_METADATA_TYPES` …; a `flow` or `action` override is not served until ADR-0146 D9's conditions land)"). See ④, must-fix 1.
- "no `?package`, `?package=hotcrm`, the layered read and both lists serve it", stamped `_packageId: 'hotcrm'` — **right** for the five served types (`_packageId: real` / `_packageId: served.overrideOf` stamps; AGREEMENT pin).
- "the env-wide list holds one item per name one code package ships (a dependent's stays under its own `?package=`)" — **right** (`soleShippingPackage` narrowing in `readFlattenedMetaItems`, `package` type exempt).
- "a package-unbound Setup row still wins over the base's until D11" — **right** (candidate order: pair override, package's own row, unbound row; the unbound row beats the code document, ADR-0146 D8 item 1 / D11).
- "An undeclared pair row or a dependent's row is an orphan in the layered read's `overlay`, `effective` = the base's" — **right** (orphan block; reported only when no other overlay is served, which the skill does not say — acceptable compression).
- "An override may narrow a public form's anonymous intake, never re-open one any honoured body withdrew" — **right** (`findPublicFormView(items, [...items, ...perPackage], slug)`).
- "`GET /packages/hotcrm.custom/export` carries it with `overrides`; the base's is unchanged" — **right** (`packages.ts` export reads `getMetaItemsPerPackage`; `clean` drops `_`-prefixed keys only).
- Eval case 10 adds an accept set (`hotcrm.custom`, `overrides:`, `package: 'hotcrm'`, `basedOn`) and a refuse set (`objectExtensions`, `allowEnvironmentOverlay`) — **right in direction**: `crm_account_grid` is a `view`, which IS served on `main`; an object extension adds fields and replaces no view (D10). Caveat in ④ should-fix 2.
- SKILL.md deletions: the CLI cheat-sheet block (rows live in `references/operations.md` :10–:25, :78, :96 — but see ④ should-fix 1 for two parentheticals that do not), the "Runtime rule of thumb" table (Local dev / Production rows restate the paragraph above; the Control plane row's content lives in `references/plugin-development.md` :305–:314), the naming sentence (folded into **Object naming** :130 — `tableName` and `sys_metadata` refusals both kept in SKILL.md as the ratchet row's own comment requires; `snake_case` stays in Naming Conventions :222; only "keep object names short" is dropped, no gate or eval reads it), the seed `object`-derived sentence (home: `objectstack-data/references/seeds.md` :50 "`object` · derived · Auto-set from `objectDef.name` — never write manually", reached by the sentence that stays), two doubled `---` — **right**, each with the home named.
- No public surface moves: no `packages/spec` file, no runtime code, no frontmatter, no `meta.json` (no new page) — **right**.

### ② Semver level

`'@objectstack/skills': patch` matches what the diff publishes: body text of one SKILL.md and one eval fixture, no frontmatter, no schema, no behaviour. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` are right on the PR body and the changeset — the protocol change was PR #28507's (`Metadata-protocol: semantic`, `Clause-②: yes (widening)`); this PR only teaches it.

The changeset's prose does **not** match the diff — must-fix 2 in ④: its third bullet says the room was made by deleting "the seed `mode` line `objectstack-data`'s `seeds.md` holds". The `mode` line is still in SKILL.md (:405–:407, held exhaustive over `SeedMode` by `check-skill-identifier-liveness.mjs` binding `seed-modes`); what was deleted is the seed `object`-is-derived sentence. The changeset is the text that `changeset version` compiles into the shipped CHANGELOG, and AGENTS.md routes a factual error there to a dedicated docs-only PR afterwards — so it is fixed before merge, not after.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Deviation 1 (seed `mode` line kept; `object` sentence and table deleted instead).** Verified: `scripts/check-skill-identifier-liveness.mjs` registers `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` `## Seed Data` exhaustive over `SeedMode` (`id: 'seed-modes'`, "The mode table is the only place an author learns what `mode` accepts"), ledger maintainer-only — deleting the line would red the gate; the substitution was the right call. Every deleted rule's home checked (① above). Nothing re-wrapped to win room: the SKILL.md hunks are pure deletions plus one changed line (:130) and one added paragraph (:134); no untouched line is reflowed. **Answered**, with one residue (should-fix 1): the cheat sheet's two migrate parentheticals ("additive sync never alters existing columns"; "loosening only; `--allow-destructive` for drops/tightenings") are NOT in `references/operations.md` :96 ("forward-only — no batch rollback") or anywhere else in the platform skill; the PR body's "every line is a row of `references/operations.md`" is true of the commands, not of those two rules. `--allow-destructive` keeps a home in `objectstack-data/SKILL.md` :267–:268 and `rules/indexing.md` :181, and the platform skill's own eval 5 names it in `expected_output` (its `must_contain` does not, so the eval still passes).
- **Deviation 2 (generated `content/docs/references/**` untouched).** Right: AUTO-GEN per AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails; `references/kernel/override-declaration.mdx` exists on `main` and on the head, is listed in `references/kernel/meta.json` (:38), and the subsection's link `/docs/references/kernel/override-declaration` uses the site's link form (`/docs/references/...`, 16+ existing uses); Check Documentation Links is green. **Answered.**
- **Ratchet row 6014, landed at 6014.** Confirmed by arithmetic on the blobs, not by a run: SKILL.md is 24073 bytes on the head (24042 on `main`); the row's convention `ceil((wc -c − version-line bytes) / 4)` with the version line at 20 bytes gives `ceil(24053 / 4) = 6014` (main: `ceil(24022 / 4) = 6006`). Headroom 0, no ceiling moves. The Lint lanes that run the ratchet are green.
- **open_questions[0] ("Runtime rule of thumb" table may be more than restatement).** Answered: Local dev and Production rows restate the paragraph above them; the Control plane row (metadata storage, revisions, history, overlays) is taught in `references/plugin-development.md` :305–:314, which SKILL.md's Part 2 pointer names. No raise needed; the fallback (tighten the paragraph) is not needed for this either.
- **open_questions[1] (seed `mode` line stayed).** Answered above.
- **out_of_scope_findings.** The exit-3 "prerequisite not met" gates are a build-order artefact, not a finding; the seat-report correction ("no page mentions `.custom`" was true of hand-written pages only) is accurate — the per-page overlap check below confirms it.
- **dispatch-gates --ran 71/71.** Not re-run here; CI's lanes are the record and are green.

### ④ Design judgment

**Must-fix 1 — the honoured-type sentence over-promises six types (SKILL.md :134; metadata-lifecycle.mdx :130–:133).** As derived in ①: on `main`, `declinesStoredRow` seals every artifact-backed name whose type the overlay whitelist does not admit, and it runs before `isServedOverrideRowOf` on every read; the override is therefore served for `view`, `dashboard`, `report`, `email_template` and `translation` only. The skill names `OVERRIDABLE_METADATA_TYPES` (thirteen types) and carves out only `flow`/`action`, so an agent asked to customize a HotCRM `page` or `app` will write a `hotcrm.custom` item with `overrides` and expect every read to serve it — the read declines it, `effective` stays the base's, and it is reported as nothing (it is neither orphan nor served). That is the "one wrong sentence written to an AI" the triage path names. The fix is a few bytes either way: say "only for a type the overlay whitelist admits today — `view`, `dashboard`, `report`, `email_template`, `translation`; the rest of `OVERRIDABLE_METADATA_TYPES` (`page`, `app`, … and `flow`/`action`) wait for their doors" in both places, and drop the bare `flow`/`action` carve-out. The paragraph's byte cost can be paid by trimming "(its `manifest.id`/`manifest.version`)" or the `?package` enumeration; no ceiling raise is needed. The eval (a `view`) stays right.

**Must-fix 2 — the changeset describes a deletion that did not happen (.changeset/28509-custom-override-read-teaching.md, third bullet).** "the seed `mode` line `objectstack-data`'s `seeds.md` holds" → the seed `object`-is-derived sentence (home `seeds.md`'s `Seed` fields table). The `mode` line is still there. One phrase.

**Should-fix 1 — the migrate rules lost their only home in the platform skill.** Either restore "`os migrate apply` loosens only; `--allow-destructive` for drops/tightenings" into `references/operations.md`'s `os migrate` row (:96; that file is priced at 3125, so measure) or point that row at `objectstack-data` SKILL.md's migration table. The "additive sync never alters existing columns" half was already inconsistent with "loosening only" and need not return.

**Should-fix 2 — eval 10's refuse set.** `must_not_contain: ["objectExtensions"]` fails a right answer that contrasts the two mechanisms by key ("not `objectExtensions` — that adds fields") — the fixture's own `expected_output` avoids the token only by paraphrase. `allowEnvironmentOverlay` catches little: neither the skill (SKILL.md never mentions it) nor a Setup-overlay answer would spell the registry key. A sharper refuse token for the wrong path is a Setup write spelling such as `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/crm_account_grid` with no `?package`, or "Setup". Not a defect of the accept set: `hotcrm.custom`, `overrides:`, `package: 'hotcrm'`, `basedOn` cannot be present in a wrong answer and absent from a right one.

**Holds.** Every other sentence of SKILL.md :134, the docs subsection (facts 1–3, 5; `overlay` = the override and `effective` = the override in the layered read matches protocol.ts, not ADR-0146 D8's `override` label — the docs are right to follow the code) and the forms.mdx sentence (fact 4: `resolveFormBySlug` judges withdrawal against `[...items, ...perPackage]`, so the base's own document and a dependent's withdrawing row still close the form) hold against `main`. The "which depends on it" claim is D3 and the install door already requires the dependency of a pair-shaped id (the #28507 test's `install` helper documents it). The docs subsection sits under *Package-first authoring (ADR-0070)*, the page that owns `?package=`, read-only installed packages and `getMetaItemLayered()` :49, and its "the overlay row of the table below" correctly names the `## Overlay whitelist` table that follows; no `meta.json` change is owed. Per-page overlap: no hand-written page under `content/docs` mentioned `.custom`, `basedOn`, `overrides.package` or `hotcrm.custom` before this PR (the hits outside these two pages are theming `overrides`, RLS `overrides` and release notes); the generated `references/kernel/override-declaration.mdx` carries the zod docblock, which the subsection links rather than restates beyond its one-sentence lead — no duplication. The PR body's table of pages checked-and-not-edited is accurate against the tree (`metadata-api.mdx` and `metadata-service.mdx` document no `?package=`/export; `build-without-code.mdx` :38 stays true until D11).

**Judged on the tree, not the PR body**: the body's "every line is a row of `references/operations.md`" (should-fix 1) and the changeset's `mode`-line sentence (must-fix 2) are the two places the account and the tree disagree; the type-set over-claim (must-fix 1) is one the body shares with the tree.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-i8f3y5`
Reviewed-by: `session_01L9qibzCtJt8Q2Z63fyRNix`

**VERDICT: FAIL**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `d3ed505db3d5a0b156f2c7601de6277948522584`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md, skills/objectstack-platform/evals/config-plugins-ops.json + skills/objectstack-platform/references/operations.md, scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs, content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx, content/docs/ui/forms.mdx, .changeset/28509-custom-override-read-teaching.md, packages/spec/src/kernel/customization-package.ts (OVERRIDE_TYPE_CLASSIFICATION / OVERRIDABLE_METADATA_TYPES), packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-plugin.zod.ts (allowEnvironmentOverlay rows), packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts (declinesStoredRow, isSealedManagedItem, OVERLAY_ALLOWED_TYPES, servedOverlayRowCandidates, readFlattenedMetaItems, getMetaItemLayered), packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-lock-state.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/served-override.ts, packages/rest/src/form-routes.ts, packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts, skills/objectstack-data/references/seeds.md, skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md, scripts/check-skill-identifier-liveness.mjs, docs/adr/0146 (D2, D3, D8, D9, D10, D11)

Delta review of the one fix commit `d3ed505d` on `4b337ddd` (`git diff 4b337ddd..refs/review/pr-28586`: 6 files, +14/−14), judged against the FAIL record 6554826982 on the previous head; everything that record found to hold is unchanged by this commit and is not re-derived here. Merge base is still `071bda62`; `origin/main` is at `d94dd3a6`, which touches none of these files.

Check-runs on `d3ed505d` at the time of writing: completed and `success` — Auto Label, Build Core, Check Changeset, Check Documentation Links, Check PR Size, Dogfood Regression Gate, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Live E2E UI, PR-body guards, Plan Test Core shards, Spec property liveness, Test UI, Type Check · debt ledger, Type Check · workspace, filter. Still running — Build Docs, all eight Lint lanes (the skills token ratchet and `check:skill-identifier-liveness` run there), Test Core 1–4/8, Type Check · consumer gates and · source gates. None has failed. The ratchet rows below are confirmed by arithmetic on the blobs, so the verdict does not wait on the Lint lanes.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Must-fix 1 (honoured-type sentence) — resolved, right.** SKILL.md :134 now reads "today only for a view, dashboard, report, email_template or translation (page, app, dataset, doc, book, mapping, flow and action wait for their doors)"; metadata-lifecycle.mdx :130–:133 says the same, keeping the `OVERRIDABLE_METADATA_TYPES` symbol and listing the eight waiting types. Against `main`: the five served types are exactly the `allowEnvironmentOverlay: true` rows of `DEFAULT_METADATA_TYPE_REGISTRY` (`view` :935, `dashboard` :937, `report` :943, `translation` :1155, `email_template` :1156 — no other row is `true`), i.e. the `OVERLAY_ALLOWED_TYPES` set that `isSealedManagedItem` → `declinesStoredRow` lets through before `isServedOverrideRowOf` is asked; the eight waiting types are `OVERRIDABLE_METADATA_TYPES` (thirteen `overridable` rows of `OVERRIDE_TYPE_CLASSIFICATION`) minus those five — `page`, `app`, `dataset`, `doc`, `book`, `mapping`, `flow`, `action` — nothing missing, nothing extra. The symbol name leaves SKILL.md (the docs page keeps it); an agent reading the constant now gets the sentence that explains why it is wider than what is served.
- **Must-fix 2 (changeset names a deletion that did not happen) — resolved, right.** The third bullet now names "the seed `object`-is-derived sentence `objectstack-data`'s `seeds.md` holds"; the `mode` line stays in SKILL.md :405–:407 as before. The bullet also records the `os migrate` row restoration and "the SKILL.md ceiling lowers to its new measurement; no ceiling rises" — true (operations.md's row lowers too, which the bullet does not say; "no ceiling rises" covers it).
- **Should-fix 1 (migrate rules lost their home) — resolved, right.** `references/operations.md` :95's `os migrate` row now reads "Preview / reconcile DB drift from metadata; `apply` loosens only, `--allow-destructive` for drops/tightenings (forward-only; `os rollback` was removed)" — the cheat sheet's `apply` rule is back in the platform skill, beside the command it governs, consistent with `objectstack-data/SKILL.md` :267–:268. The "additive sync never alters existing columns" half was not restored, as the record said it need not be.
- **Should-fix 2 (eval 10's refuse set) — replaced, mostly right, one residue.** `must_not_contain` is now `["PUT /api/v1/meta/view/crm_account_grid", "PUT /meta/view/crm_account_grid"]`, the package-less Setup write spelling the lifecycle page documents (`PUT /api/v1/meta/view/case_grid`, :82). Can a wrong Setup answer avoid both? Yes — "open Setup → Views and edit it" or the plural spelling `PUT /api/v1/meta/views/crm_account_grid` passes the refuse set; it still fails the accept set (`hotcrm.custom`, `overrides:`, `package: 'hotcrm'`, `basedOn` cannot all appear in an answer that edits in place), which is what carries the case. Can a right answer contain either? Yes, as a substring: the pair-scoped REST write is `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/crm_account_grid?package=hotcrm.custom` (a save naming a package is the write `servedOverlayRowCandidates` describes and the lifecycle page's `?package=` forms), and a right answer that spells it fails on the prefix. No skill or docs page spells a `PUT …?package=` write today and the fixture's `expected_output` authors the item in the package, so the residue is narrow. Should-fix, not blocking: see ④.
- **New surface — `references/operations.md` :52.** The clause "`os build` additionally emits the artifact" is deleted and the paragraph re-wrapped from four lines to three — a reflow of the edited paragraph only, no other line of the file moves. The rule has two homes in the same file: the code-block comment :38 "`os build        # the same three gates, plus emits dist/objectstack.json`" and the Build & runtime table :22 "`os build` | Compile TS metadata, bundle, and produce `dist/`". **Right.**
- **New surface — `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`.** `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` 6014 → 6012; `skills/objectstack-platform/references/operations.md` 3125 → 3119. Measured on the head blobs with the script's own convention: SKILL.md is 24065 bytes with a 20-byte `version:` stamp line → `ceil(24045 / 4) = 6012`; operations.md is 12475 bytes, no stamp → `ceil(12475 / 4) = 3119`. Both rows equal the measurement, both move down (operations.md on `main` is 12494 bytes → 3124 under a 3125 row; the fix pays 19 bytes net and the row is re-pinned at the measurement), neither rises. **Right.** The row comments above each ceiling are not updated (they still narrate the 6014 arithmetic); the script's self-test reads the numbers, not the comments, so this is prose debt, not a gate concern.
- No public surface moves in the fix commit: no `packages/spec` file, no runtime code, no frontmatter. **Right.**

### ② Semver level

Unchanged and still right: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`; `Clause-②: no`; `Metadata-protocol: none` on the PR body and the changeset. The changeset's prose now matches the diff (the `object`-sentence correction, the five served types, the `os migrate` row, the lowered ceiling, the Setup-write refuse set); no sentence in it describes something the tree does not do.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **The PR body still describes `4b337ddd`.** Stale against the tree at `d3ed505d`: "Head `4b337ddd`" (Verification); "Five files" (six: `references/operations.md` and the ratchet script are added); "`6014 / 6014 (+0)`", "6006 → **6014** … headroom 8 → 0", "No ratchet row moves" (now 6012/6012 and 3119/3119, two rows lowered); the two-minute verification's expected `6014 / 6014 (+0)`; eval 10's `must_not_contain` "`objectExtensions`, `allowEnvironmentOverlay`" (now the two Setup-write spellings); the acceptance note "the skill says 'not `flow`/`action` yet'" and the What-changes row "only for an overridable type (`OVERRIDABLE_METADATA_TYPES` …; not `flow`/`action` yet)" (now the five served / eight waiting split); "every line is a row of `references/operations.md`" (the `apply` rule is now restored into that row rather than already present). The seat's ACCEPT is where these are recorded as corrected; nothing here needs the body rewritten before merge, but the ACCEPT must carry the numbers (6012, 3119) and the six-file list so the merge record is not read off the stale body.
- **Claim surface.** The claim (6554345630) named `references/operations.md` nowhere and the ratchet row of SKILL.md "only if the measured size moves down". The fix touches `references/operations.md` and its ratchet row — the remedy the FAIL record's should-fix 1 ordered, inside the same governed skill, and the Governed Surface Queue Guard is green on the head. Escalated to the ACCEPT as a surface widening to record, not a breach to stop on.
- **Deviations 1 and 2 of the os-dev-report** stand as answered in record 6554826982; the fix commit does not touch the Seed Data section or any generated page.
- **Nothing re-wrapped to win room**: SKILL.md's hunk is the one paragraph; operations.md's are the edited paragraph (three lines for four) and the one table row; the eval and changeset hunks are single lines.

### ④ Design judgment

**Holds.** The corrected sentence in SKILL.md and the docs subsection is the read on `main` (① above), and it is the sentence an agent needs: a `hotcrm.custom` page or app override is now taught as "waits for its doors", not as served. Its byte cost was paid inside the paragraph (the opening clause tightened, the constant's name dropped from the skill), and the ceiling moved down rather than up. The forms.mdx sentence and the rest of the docs subsection are untouched and still hold. The operations.md row restores the one migrate rule that had lost its platform-skill home, in the row that lists the command, and the `os build` clause it deletes to pay for it has two homes in the same file.

**Should-fix (not blocking) — eval 10's refuse tokens match the pair-scoped write too.** `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/crm_account_grid` is a prefix of `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/crm_account_grid?package=hotcrm.custom`, so a right answer that gives the REST spelling of the write into the pair fails the case; and a wrong Setup answer with no URL passes the refuse set (the accept set still fails it). If the refuse set is meant to catch the package-less write, a token the pair-scoped spelling cannot contain is needed — e.g. the phrase the Setup path uses ("Customize with an overlay", the link ADR-0146 D11 retires) — or the two URL tokens can be dropped and the case left to its accept set, which a wrong answer cannot satisfy. Either is a one-line fixture edit; neither changes the skill.

**Note, no grade.** The two ratchet row comments still narrate 6014 / 3125 arithmetic above rows that now say 6012 / 3119. The next author who re-prices either file will read the comment's "24055 bytes" against a blob that is 24065 and have to re-derive; one line each ("6014 → 6012 on card #28509: the five-served-types rewording, re-pinned at the measurement") would close it, but the gate reads the number and the gate is right.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-i8f3y5`
